ownerStatement: Fix #1690 through the full issue-fix flow
reason: Owner-requested fix of #1690 (the AMP gain left mixing the dry signal into every filter type after TYPE passed AMP): one DSP instruction clears AMP's weight in the filter path. Reproduced and verified bit-exactly in the vendored DSP56300 interpreter (LP, one AMP block, LP against LP throughout: a -6.2 dB dry leak before, identical output after). Released after software checks, without new hardware, chip-cycle or complete memory measurements, and retaining the 0.1.3 UI captures, which this change does not touch. This binds only this exact version and native source; hardware remains untested.
